purpose: One prospectively fixed common-Greek-normalization workflow for calibration, human/translation controls, and only then a fifth exposed-data target evaluation. No new family, held-out data or confirmation.
prerequisites: Verified CAL-008 and GRC-NORM-001 reports; verify their exact report hashes against their algorithm-check reports. Preserve every older report and source input.
normalization: Use the existing Hebrew final-form fold unchanged. For ALL Greek inputs (SBLGNT, Swete and Xenophon), derive exactly the existing old stream minus iotas originating from decomposed U+0345. Retain genuine written iotas and every other letter. Assert agreement with the audited SBLGNT common-policy crosswalk and retain raw-word provenance, old/common coordinate maps and original token order. Any other letter change or disappearance of an old nonempty word is an explicit error, not an optional exclusion.
search: Unmodified FAM-003: one shared injective table, common Hebrew direction, three distinct groups on each side, eight distinct source letters per piece, full common-length maximum over 16..32. No stride, approximate substitution, joined verses, favorable transcription selection or first-witness uniqueness claim.
models: Both existing models, words and word_types, applied to the new normalized tokens. Recompute the whole search in every reference corpus. Inclusive p=(1+scores>=observed)/(199+1); no recycling of old reference scores or choosing the better model.

calibration.background: Full common-normalized SBLGNT against exactly the unchanged EXP-004 Hebrew groups. Artificial interventions only; do not scan the unmodified target during this stage.
calibration.coordinates: The same declared within-side selection algorithm as CAL-008: eligible oriented source windows have 32 available letters and eight distinct letters in their first 16; choose three distinct source groups and one eligible window per group, then three distinct Greek units of length >=32 and one within-unit start for each. Python Random(2026091900), with groups/units/starts in the same deterministic orders specified by CAL-008. Even trials forward, odd trials reverse.
calibration.mapping: Twenty fresh permutations of range(24) generated by Python Random(mapping_seed); one shared table per intervention.
calibration.implantation: Replace exactly sixteen letters at each of three fixed destinations, re-split each verse at its current COMMON-policy word lengths, and preserve all other letters, groups and units. Input copies are labelled synthetic and stored separately.
calibration.detection: Score>=16 and p<=0.01 in both models; every literal plant must be admissible and all twenty scans must reach at least 16. Record coverage of planted coordinates by the deterministic returned witness, allowing other maximal ties.
calibration.gate: At least 18/20 detections and at least 9/10 in each direction, plus all literal/score checks. Failure prevents the target run under this protocol.
calibration.scope: Calibration at the screening boundary on one exposed background and a declared source-window subset; not a new claim of universal power at all lengths or an independent natural replication of CAL-008.
calibration.execution: At most two independent concurrent native scans; persist hash-checked per-trial receipts. Reuse identical completed receipts only after input, code identity and reference-archive checks. Record any failure; no silent seed replacement.

controls.human_selection: Exactly the old Berakhot line blocks, and the same ordered Xenophon source tokens before the first U+FFFC gap, grouped into consecutive blocks of sixteen old-nonempty words. Re-normalize those same raw tokens; retain the same group/block IDs.
controls.translation_selection: Exactly the CTRL-003 DSS islands and verse groups. All pinned Swete Torah verses, one group per canonical verse reference, no cross-verse joins. Re-normalize the same nonempty raw tokens and retain their order.
controls.alert: Score>=16 and p<=0.01 in both models in either pair. An alert prevents this target run and requires a recorded review of the reference models. The translation pair is dependent, and neither pair represents all plausible human scenarios.

target.preconditions: CAL-009 gate passes; neither CTRL-004 pair alerts; independent algorithm-check report matches both current report hashes. No target scan before all three conditions hold.
target.input: Unchanged 643 DSS islands grouped into 324 references as in EXP-004, and all 7939 common-policy SBLGNT verses (679879 letters), one group per verse. No manuscript mask is used to select observations or reference corpora.
target.screen: Score>=16 and inclusive p<=0.01 under both models. This is an internal exploratory refutation trigger, never confirmation or divine-origin evidence.
target.normalization_consistency_check: If a witness exists, at least one of its full-length Greek windows must traverse a removed extra iota under the verified common-to-old coordinate map; otherwise it would contradict the unchanged-input negative EXP-004. Do not impose that all three windows change, and do not use this implication to skip randomized searches.
target.manuscript_rule: For a positive screen, enumerate tied maximizing tables/passages before claiming uniqueness. A triple is eligible for further retention only if each Greek window is entirely inside a forced exact support run in BOTH existing Sinaiticus transcriptions, assessed separately from their recorded supports at the actual match length. Report disagreements, absent and ambiguous support; the versions are one manuscript. This is a fixed necessary robustness condition applied after a full unmasked screen, not a second p-value or an assertion of independent witnesses.
target.positive_followup: A first witness is not a retained candidate. Enumerate all maximizing ties, freeze any candidate's table, direction, coordinates, normalization and complete description cost, assess every same-reference Hebrew witness without favorable selection, and attack reuse/translation explanations. Independent reserved-data confirmation and external replication remain required; all current inputs are exposed. No uniqueness or short-description claim is authorized merely by passing this screen.
target.negative_followup: Archive failure as a result on this precise normalization and bounded family; keep the goal open and review a substantively different rule family or text-stability issue before repeating another test. Do not lower minimum length or change constraints during this experiment.
target.trial_accounting: Fifth cumulative target evaluation, second target evaluation of FAM-003, three distinct families explored. The earlier choices and failed tests remain in the registry; conditional randomization diagnostics do not correct all adaptive research history. Zero confirmation budget spent.

resource_guards: Unchanged per-scan limits of 1000000 compatible seeds and 50000000 compatibility checks; explicit failure instead of truncation.
verification: Independently reconstruct common Greek tokens and grouping for all three pairs, every implant and word boundary, all observed maxima and seed counts, all p-values/gates, and first/last reference corpora per model/input. Verify target and manuscript diagnostics if a target witness exists. Do not claim independent scientific replication or independent recomputation of every intervening reference score.
registration: Entire workflow fixed locally before any common-policy scan; no external preregistration or sealed reserve. Existing common Greek corpus, individual counts and negative old-policy results are already exposed.
